skill.name: brand-landingpage
skill.description: Guides a brand discovery interview, turns answers into a Stitch design system, generates landing page drafts, manages feedback loops, and packages deployment-ready HTML.
skill.summary: Create brand-guided landing pages with Stitch and a structured design workflow.
skill.author: wshobson

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives from Markdown code spans around file names, Stitch tool names, and documentation links. Confirmed issues are limited to host-affecting actions: opening HTML with OS commands, creating a zip through zip -r, and checking an API key environment variable. No prompt injection attempt or data exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user consent before installing packages. Prefer project-local installs and pin package names to official Stitch documentation.
Use a safe preview API when available. Otherwise ask before launching external programs and strictly quote local file paths.

remediation.issue: Zip creation through a shell command
remediation.suggestion: Prefer a built-in archive library. If zip is used, sanitize project names and keep all paths inside the generated bundle directory.
Only verify whether the key exists. Never display, persist, or copy the key, and avoid reading .env contents without user consent.

semantic_findings.description: The skill instructs the agent to install the Stitch SDK if missing, with global install as the default. Automatic global package installation can modify the host environment and execute package lifecycle scripts.

content.value_statement: Many product teams need a polished landing page before they have clear brand direction. This skill guides discovery, creates a Stitch design system, iterates designs, and delivers deployable HTML.
actual_capabilities: Runs a structured brand interview for product, audience, CTA, and visual direction.
Maps answers to Stitch color mode, color variant, font, and roundness settings.
Creates Stitch projects, design systems, desktop screens, and optional mobile screens.
Saves generated HTML versions and session state in a .stitch workspace.
Guides feedback into edits, variants, rollback choices, and approval decisions.
Packages final HTML, design notes, tokens, assets, and a deployment checklist.
limitations: Requires Stitch SDK access, a Stitch API key, and working generation tools.
Focused on single landing pages, not dashboards, multi-page apps, or component libraries.
Stitch output is static HTML, so custom app logic needs separate implementation.
Uploaded logos are saved for handoff, but they are not embedded directly by Stitch.

use_cases.title: Launch a SaaS Homepage
use_cases.description: Turn a product idea, audience, CTA, and brand preferences into a first landing page draft.

use_cases.title: Present an Open Source Project
use_cases.description: Create a clear project page with a hero, feature sections, setup flow, and GitHub-focused CTA.

use_cases.title: Refine a Developer Tool Brand
use_cases.description: Convert technical positioning into visual direction, then iterate page variants from structured feedback.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Landing Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a new project with limited brand direction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a landing page for my product. Start by interviewing me about the audience, CTA, brand feel, colors, typography, and shape direction.

prompt_templates.title: Use Existing Context
prompt_templates.scenario: Provide a README, product description, or notes before the interview.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the product notes I provide to extract the project name, pitch, audience, and features. Ask only the missing brand and CTA questions.

prompt_templates.title: Iterate a Draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve a generated Stitch page after reviewing it in the browser.
prompt_templates.prompt: Open the latest generated landing page and help me review message clarity, CTA visibility, color fit, reading flow, and credibility.

prompt_templates.title: Package for Handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt after desktop and optional mobile layouts are approved.
prompt_templates.prompt: After I approve the final layout, package the landing page with HTML, design notes, color tokens, saved assets, and a deployment checklist.

output_examples.input: A founder asks for a landing page for a new developer API.
output_examples.output: The assistant asks focused brand questions, builds a technical design direction, generates a desktop page, and opens it for review.

output_examples.input: A maintainer provides a README and asks for a project homepage.
output_examples.output: The assistant extracts product details, asks for CTA and brand feel, creates variants, and packages the approved static page.

output_examples.input: A team likes the layout but dislikes the colors.
output_examples.output: The assistant keeps the layout, creates color-focused alternatives, asks for a preferred direction, and saves the selected version.

best_practices: Share the project name, target users, and primary CTA before generation starts.
Provide three brand adjectives and one site you admire when possible.
Review browser previews and fix message clarity before tuning small visual details.
anti_patterns: Using this skill for dashboards, full applications, documentation sites, or component-level UI work.
Skipping the brand interview and expecting a specific visual identity from little context.
Treating generated static HTML as production app logic without engineering review.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates brand-guided landing page drafts with Stitch, then packages approved static HTML and design notes.

faq.question: Does it need Stitch access?
faq.answer: Yes. It expects the Stitch SDK or MCP tools and a configured Stitch API key.

faq.question: Can it build a full website?
faq.answer: No. It is designed for a single landing page or homepage, not a multi-page site.

faq.question: Can it use my logo or screenshots?
faq.answer: It can save provided assets for handoff and reflect your description, but Stitch does not directly upload images.

faq.question: What happens after the first draft?
faq.answer: It opens the page for review, asks structured feedback questions, and turns feedback into edits or variants.

faq.question: What files are delivered?
faq.answer: The bundle can include final HTML, optional mobile HTML, design documentation, color tokens, assets, and a deployment checklist.
